analysis.title: GS Ellinikaki - Positioning Update where are we now? 21 Oct 2026
key_insights: Hedge fund data is consistent with HFs reducing tilts and directional bias rather than outright derisking: gross leverage is still elevated while net leverage is much lower.
Global Info Tech stocks saw the largest 2-week % net selling (Oct 5 to Oct 16) on record (10+ years, -3.3 SDs), driven by both long sales and short sales.
Net allocation to Global AI stocks (GSXGGLAI) is in the 38th percentile, and the aggregate long/short ratio across the group is in the 6th percentile vs the past year.
Mag 7 net exposure has risen to a new record high, while the gap between US Semis and Software net exposures has continued to narrow.
Long/Short ratio in US Cyclicals (GSXUCYCL) is in the 5th percentile, approaching 3-year lows, which the desk reads as HFs becoming more cautious on the growth outlook.
HFs have heavily net sold global equities so far in October, with short sales outpacing long buys by about 5 to 1.
Long leverage is in the 73rd percentile vs the past year (94th percentile over 5 years), while Short leverage has risen sharply and is in the 99th percentile, approaching 5-year highs.
Fundamental L/S gross leverage rose 5.4 pts in October MTD to 211.9%, while Fundamental L/S net leverage fell 3.1 pts MTD to 49.4%, in the 1st percentile over 1 year.

Rising caution on the growth outlook, as shown by the US Cyclicals long/short ratio near 3-year lows.
